tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The one ground everything is pressed from: page background and the face of every raised or sunken element. Neumorphism needs surfaces to share it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised controls and cards. Same as canvas on purpose: elevation comes from the shadow pair, never from a lighter fill.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: inputs, the composer field, the segmented-control track, the switch track, reply quotes.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Things that float above the page instead of being pressed from it: menus, popovers, toasts, dialogs. Pair with shadow-float.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on canvas, surface, surface-sunken, surface-overlay and accent-tint. 9:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: blurbs, helper lines, the other person's nickname. Legible on every neutral and on accent-tint.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: placeholders, timestamps, counts. Still 4.5:1 on every neutral, so it can carry meaning.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines that separate without carrying meaning (list dividers, the edge highlight on raised cards).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that must be seen: the input underline, checkbox frames, the focus-visible edge of a well. 3:1 on canvas and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Amber: the one brand hue. Primary button fill, the selected mode, the focus ring, the expiry ring, live indicators. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as text: links, the active nav label, your own read ticks. 4.5:1 on canvas, overlay and accent-tint.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Dark in Dusk because the accent lightens there.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Your own message bubble and the selected reaction chip. ink, ink-soft and accent-ink all read on it.

tokens.name: accent-glow
tokens.usage: Soft halo for live states only (speaking tile, recording, the send spark). Never a resting decoration.

tokens.name: mode-text
tokens.usage: Text rooms. Mode colors appear as a dot, a ring or a tint, never as large fills.

tokens.name: mode-voice
tokens.usage: Voice rooms: dot, ring, chip text. 4.5:1 on canvas and mode-voice-tint.

tokens.name: mode-voice-tint
tokens.usage: Voice chip and voice card wash.

tokens.name: mode-video
tokens.usage: Video rooms: dot, ring, chip text. 4.5:1 on canvas and mode-video-tint.

tokens.name: mode-video-tint
tokens.usage: Video chip and video card wash.

tokens.name: online
tokens.usage: Presence and success. Always next to a word or count ("3 online"): never color alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Reconnecting, weak connection. Always with a label. Leans yellow so it never reads as the amber accent.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive confirmations. Always with a label or icon; distinct from the amber accent by a red lean and a darker tone.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus-visible ring: 2px canvas gap, then 2px ring. 3:1 or better on every surface it lands on.

tokens.name: shadow-light
tokens.usage: The lit side of a neumorphic shadow (light comes from the top left). Used by the shadow tokens; use it directly only for a custom elevation.

tokens.name: shadow-dark
tokens.usage: The shaded side of a neumorphic shadow (bottom right).

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Call stage background. Video reads best on near-black, so calls stay dark in both themes.

tokens.name: stage-raised
tokens.usage: Tiles and the control dock on the stage.

tokens.name: stage-ink
tokens.usage: Names and icons on the stage and stage-raised.

shadow.note: Neumorphic pairs (light from the top left) for things pressed from the canvas, shadow-float for overlays, shadow-glow for live states.

tokens.name: shadow-raised-sm
tokens.usage: Small raised things: reaction chips, icon buttons, the switch knob, message bubbles.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Default raised: buttons, cards, the composer bar, nav pill.

tokens.name: shadow-raised-lg
tokens.usage: Hero cards and the one focal surface of a screen (lobby mode cards on hover, the landing card). At most one per screen.

tokens.name: shadow-inset
tokens.usage: Wells and pressed states: inputs, the composer field, tracks, a pressed button.

tokens.name: shadow-inset-sm
tokens.usage: Small pressed things: a selected reaction chip, the reply quote, an active nav item.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Overlays that leave the surface: menus, popovers, toasts, dialogs. Neumorphic shadows are for things pressed from the canvas, this one for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Live states only: the speaking tile, an active recording, the send spark's flash.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on any control (with :focus-visible). Combine with the control's own shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-stage-raised
tokens.usage: Tiles and the control dock on the call stage. The stage is dark in both themes, so this pair is the same in both.

tokens.name: shadow-stage-inset
tokens.usage: Wells on the stage: the voice orb, the volume track.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Unbounded: wide, rounded and confident. Headlines, room names and big numbers only; never running text.

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: Words that vanish in ten minutes.
styles.usage: The landing headline. One per page.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: The room name in the chat header; card titles on the landing page.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Mode card titles, dialog titles, section heads.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Figtree: friendly and very legible at chat sizes. Everything people read and type.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick text, voice, or video. Everything disappears ten minutes after the last message.
styles.usage: Prose: landing copy, empty states, explanations. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: message
styles.sample: anyone up for a quick call?
styles.usage: Message bubbles. Never smaller: chat is the product.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels and the other person's nickname above a message run.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Talk live, with text chat beside you.
styles.usage: Helper text, mode card blurbs, chip text.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: JetBrains Mono for anything copied, counted or compared: codes, timers, pseudonyms, metrics.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Invite codes, in the field and on the ticket.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Timestamps, the expiry countdown, read marks, pseudonym ids.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Monitoring numbers and live counts (tabular figures).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, dot to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; between stacked bubbles of one person.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside buttons and inputs (vertical); between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and composer padding; the phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between messages from different people.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a card; the desktop side gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between cards; above a section title.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between page sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Around the landing hero.

radius.note: Generous and soft; pills for anything you toggle.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Reply quotes, small chips' inner wells.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, icon buttons' squares, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, message bubbles, menu panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the composer bar, call tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero cards, dialogs, the call stage.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills: nav, segmented control, chips, switches, the send button.

duration.note: Motion timing. prefers-reduced-motion drops every duration above dur-fast to 0.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Press-in (a button sinking into the surface).

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover lift, chip toggles, menu open.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Most transitions: bubbles arriving, tabs, panels.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Page-level entrances and the segmented thumb travel.

tokens.name: dur-signature
tokens.usage: The few signature moments (a message shredding at expiry, the match reveal).

tokens.name: dur-ambient
tokens.usage: One slow loop of an ambient background.

tokens.name: ease-soft
tokens.usage: Default: things settling into the surface.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Small overshoot for thumbs, knobs and chips.

tokens.name: ease-press
tokens.usage: Press-in and release.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Leaving: toasts out, messages expiring.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Sticky header and the mobile tab bar.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs and their backdrop.
